extDescr.message: Mezdia Proxy Switcher — manage and switch proxies in your browser

TEXT_EMPTY_LIST.message: No proxies added yet. Go to Import tab to add proxies.

TEXT_SETTINGS_INFO.message: These settings are applied when switching proxy

TEXT_EXCLUDE_URLS_HINT.message: Type a domain and press Enter or comma to add. Spaces are ignored. Supports plain domains (Mezdia.ir) or patterns (*.example.com). Click × to remove.

TEXT_HELP_FOOTER.message: Lines starting with # are treated as comments. Protocol prefix (http:, https:, socks5:) is optional — defaults to HTTP if omitted. Credentials format: user:password@ip:port or ip:port:user:password.

TEXT_SCOPE_INFO.message: Choose whether proxy affects the entire browser or only tabs in the Mezdia group

TEXT_CREATE_GROUP.message: Create Mezdia Group from Current Tab

TEXT_TIP1_DESC.message: In Group mode, the proxy only applies to websites open in tabs belonging to the Mezdia group. All other tabs connect directly without a proxy. This lets you browse with and without proxy simultaneously.

TEXT_TIP2_DESC.message: Click the 'Create Mezdia Group' button above to add the current tab to a new group named Mezdia. You can also right-click any tab, select 'Add tab to group', then name the group exactly 'Mezdia' (case-sensitive).

TEXT_TIP3_DESC.message: To add more tabs, right-click the tab, select 'Add tab to group', and choose the Mezdia group. You can also drag and drop tabs into the group. The proxy will automatically apply to new domains opened in these tabs.

TEXT_TIP4_DESC.message: The proxy configuration updates automatically when you add or remove tabs from the Mezdia group, or when a tab navigates to a new domain. Changes take effect within about one second.

TEXT_TIP5_DESC.message: Proxy routing is based on domain names. If the same domain is open in both a Mezdia tab and a regular tab, the proxy will apply to ALL requests to that domain. For complete separation, use different domains in each context.

TEXT_GRP_UNTITLED_NOTE.message: This browser can't name tab groups, so the proxy follows the group this button creates.
